name: Zanabazar
sum: Large troodontid from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia, first named as a species of Saurornithoides.
holotype: IGM 100/1, a nearly complete skull and braincase, part of the pelvis, tail vertebrae and parts of the right hind limb, Mongolia (Barsbold 1974, as Saurornithoides junior).
biology: Reclassified in its own genus in 2009 and named after Zanabazar, the first spiritual head of Tibetan Buddhism in Mongolia.
author: Norell et al. 2009

sources.text: M. A. Norell, P. J. Makovicky, and G. S. Bever, A. M. Balanoff, J. M. Clark, R. Barsbold, T. Rowe. 2009. A review of the Mongolian Cretaceous dinosaur Saurornithoides (Troodontidae: Theropoda). American Museum Novitates 3654:1-63
